court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Sanju vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of U.P. And 2 Others (wife? and others)

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed a writ petition to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 24.11.2022 in Case Crime No. 613 of 2022, under various IPC sections and Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the petitioner to establish that the impugned FIR is malafide.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the court cannot quash a complaint or an FIR merely because it is alleged that the police officer has acted in a biased manner.

legal_principles.principle: The court cannot quash a complaint or an FIR merely because it is alleged that the police officer has acted in a biased manner.

outcome.final_order: The writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
